Desalination：ASolutiontothe World,s WaterProblems？
Fresh water is very important for life, but many people do not think about
where it comes from.
We use water every day for many activities.
However,
we often forget that fresh water comes from lakes, rivers, and sources under
the ground, and these water sources are limited.
Therefore, we need to be
careful to save water and not waste
it.
Without fresh water, it would be hard
for people, animals and plants to live.
Water shortages happen when there
is not enough clean water fOr people
to use.
This can be caused by pollution, or by growing demand due to an
increase in the population.
In addition, some countries have dry weather and
do not get enOugh rain.
When there are water shortages,
it leaves less water
for drinking, cooking, washing, industry, and agriculture.
The water shortage
problem is even seen in countries that are close to oceans.
Even though these
countries are surrounded bv water, the water contains salt and thev cannot use
the salt water without treating it first.
Desalination
is the process that makes
salt water from the ocean safe to
drink, by removing the salt and other harmful substances.
It can therefore help
people in places near the ocean where there is not enough fresh water.
There
are several methods
of desalination.
One method
is
called "reverse osmosis"
and
it involves several steps.
First, salt water is transported from the ocean to
the desalination plant.
Then, the water goes through special filters to remove
sand and other large particles.
Next, the water
is put through a thin layer
of material called a membrane to remove the
salt.
After that, minerals and
other chemicals are added
to the water to make
it clean.
This ensures that
it is drinkable and stays safe.
Finally, the clean water is distributed to people
and businesses to consume.
Access to clean water is important because it can
prevent problems caused by water shortages like hunger, disease and other
－③－28－

medical conditions, fewer economic opportunities, and even connicts.
One advantage of desalination is that
it can provide a large amount of
fresh water fOr drinking, farming and industry, in any season・Saudi Arabia is
a good example of a desalination success story.
It is a very dry country, but
it uses desalination to make fresh water from the ocean・In fact, Saudi Arabia
currently has over 40 desalination facilities and produces more desalinated
water than any other country.
Thanks to desalination, the country has enough
water for human and economic development.
Many of the most successful
desalination projects are in countries in the Middle East with a lot of deserts
and few natural sources of fresh water.
Another advantage of desalination is that it could help avoid water wars
between countries by giving them another way to get fresh water・For
example, tensions are rising between Egypt and Ethiopia over the Nile River.
Egypt depends on the Nile fOr almost all of its fresh water.
However, Ethiopia
has launched a project to build a large dam on the river to generate electricity.
Egypt worries that the dam can reduce the amount of fresh water nowing
north from Ethiopia to Egypt・Egypt is now building seawater desalination
facilities to get fresh water from the ocean instead of depending on the river.
Desalination facilities can be helpful, but they have some disadvantages.
The
technology and equipment needed to clean the salt water is expensive.
Because
of this, it can cost hundreds of millions of dollars to build a desalination facility.
That is why most facilities have been built in wealthy countries.
Furthermore,
the facilities use a lot of electricity to clean the water and transport
it.
This
also costs a lot of money.
In addition to being very expensive, desalination facilities can cause
problems.
For example, desalination creates waste called "brine".
Brine
is
very salty water.
The brine
is often put back into the ocean.
This can harm
sea
life because
it makes the water too saltV.
Another problem
is that most
desalination facilities use fossil fuels
like coal,
gas, or oil
This causes air
pollution and contributes to climate change.
Desalination
is just one way that we can increase our supply of fresh
water
Whether you live in an area with a lot of fresh water or not,
it
is
important to keep our water clean and drinkable・So, the next time vou drink a
glass of water or take a bath, think about where your fresh water comes from.
－③－29－
